tei:div.tei:p: (ca)༄༅// bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med 'khor dang bcas pa mchod cing gsol ba gdab pa'i cho ga thar pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo gu ru a mi ta bhā ya/ bsod nams brgya las grub pa rgyal ba'i mtshan// rgyu skar dbus na nyi ma'i mchod sdong bzhin// zhing rdul snyed kyi 'dren pa zil gnon pa// bde chen zhing gi mgon po la phyag 'tshal// thugs rje'i mnga' bdag shākya'i rgyal po yis// gdul bya byang chub lam du 'dren pa'i thabs// ji snyed gsungs las bya sla don che ba// da ltar sangs rgyas mngon sum bzhugs pa'i mdo// bde chen zhing bkod 'od dpag med pa yi// mdo sde sogs las che thang bsngags pa gang*// mchog dman 'jug bde zhugs nas mi ldog pa'i// lam 'dir blo dman bdag kyang spro bas 'jug /'dir 'jug par 'dod pa'i skal ba dge ba can dag /thog mar slob dpon las lung nod par bya ste de'i tshul ni/ maṇḍal sku brnyan mchod pa'i yo byad 'du byas te/ thog mar slob dpon gyis sgom bzlas nyams su len pa ni/ sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ shū n+ya tās stong par sbyang*/ rang gi snying gar hrīḥyig dmar po yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rgyal ba 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ na bza' chos gos rnam gsum gsol ba/ tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs can/ mtshan dang dpe byad yongs su rdzogs pa'o// ye shes sems dpa' badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs kar hrīḥyig gi mthar sngags phreng dmigs la/ oṃ a mṛ ta pra bhe a mṛ ta hūm̐/ ci nus bzla/ slob ma rnams khrus dang phyag sngon tu 'gro bas 'khod pa la/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag tu med pa'i go 'phang la 'god par bya/ de'i ched du sgom bzlas kyi lung blang zhing don nyams su len par bgyi'o snyam pa'i thugs bskyed dang*/

chos gsan pa'i kun tu spyod pa'ang gsal btab nas/ gang gsan par bya ba'i chos ni/ don dam du sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam pa bzhi dang bcu la sogs pas gsang gsum phrin las dang bcas pa mnyam zhing mtshungs pa kho na yin mod kyang*/ gdul bya'i snang ngor sku tshe ring thung dang mdzad phrin rgya che chung ltar snang ba las/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag tu med pa 'di ni sngon 'das pa'i bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i snga rol du dge slong chos kyi 'byung gnas zhes bya bar gyur pa'i tshe/ bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal po'i spyan sngar byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed de/ sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa gcig gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan gyi rgyan bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa gcig tu bsdus pa las kyang ches lhag pa sngon phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du ma byung ba yongs su bzung nas/ ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i smon lam gyi khyad par mtha' yas pa btab cing mi 'jig pa'i go cha chen po bgos te mtha' yas pa'i bskal pa rnams su sems can thams cad kyi don du byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod cing smon lam chen po yang dag par bsgrubs pas dge ba'i rtsa ba mthar phyin te/ 'di nas nub phyogs su sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba khrag khrig phrag 'bum 'das pa na/ 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can zhes bya bar bla na med par yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas sku tshe'i tshad bskal pa dpag tu med par bzhugs/ 'od kyi snang bas sangs rgyas kyi zhing mtha' yas par khyab par mdzad/ dge 'dun 'dus pa'i rgya mtsho gting mtha' mi mngon pas bskor zhing*/ da ltar 'tsho zhing gzhes la chos kyang ston te sems can gang dag bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med de'i mtshan thos nas dad pa skad cig tsam skyes pas kyang bla na med pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog cing bud med kyi lus kyi tha mar 'gyur/

dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed cing bsam pa thag pa nas zhing der skye ba'i phyir yongs su bsngos na 'chi 'phos ma thag 'od dpag med dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pa mngon sum mthong nas 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can tu skyes te byang chub spyod pa dpag tu med pa spyad nas myur du 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba sogs rmad du byung ba'i rnam par thar pa la/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi mgrin gcig tu mtshan dang grags pa sgrog cing bsngags pa mtha' yas pa rtag tu gsungs par mdzad pa de lta bu'i ngo mtshar ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de nyid kyi bzlas lung sgrub thabs dang bcas pa 'phags yul lho phyogs ra khang tsagmar sku 'khrungs pa'i paṇḍi ta shākya rakṣi ta la rdo rje rnal 'byor mas dngos su stsal/ de nas grub pa'i slob dpon rim par brgyud de paṇḍi ta gang ba'i rdo rje las rtsod pa'i dus kyi rdo rje 'chang chen po tā ra nā thas gsan te rgyal tshab rgya mtsho rnam gnyis sogs las/ rtsa ba'i bla ma 'di zhes bya ba'i bar gdams ngag gi bka' ma chad par byon pa de lta bu'i bzlas lung sgrub par byed pa la/ slob dpon gyis sgom bzlas sngon du grub nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa sgom bzlas kyi lung zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul 'tshal/ zhes mtshams sbyar nas maṇḍal 'bul du gzhug de nas theg pa che chung gi lam gyi sgrub thabs thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro ba skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs sogs lan gsum/ khyad par du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ slob dpon gyis bdag la rig sngags dam pa stsal du gsol/ lan gsum/ de nas khyed rang rnams gzhan du ma yengs par lha'i rnal 'byor 'di bzhin du sgoms 'tshal/ zhes brda sbyar la/

shū n+ya tās stong par sbyang*/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar hrīḥyig dmar po/ zhes pa nas/ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ yan mngon rtogs ltar brjod/ slob dpon lhar gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba la sngags kyi phreng ba/ mos gus mdzad pas sngags phreng gnyis pa chad de zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams lhar gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du 'khod par mos la sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ ces sngags kyi rjes zlos lan gsum grub mthar/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung gi byin rlabs dang*/ khyad par bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag tu med pa'i gsung rig sngags kyi nus mthu thams cad rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams kyi ngag la thogs med du 'jug par gyur cig ces brjod/ sngags kyi rjes zlos skabs phreng ba sbrel/ mthar mgo la 'jog par mdzad/ des bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med kyi sgom bzlas legs par phul grub pa yin pas gtang rag tu maṇḍal dang*/ dge bsngo byas pas 'grub bo// 'di ni rgyud sde gang rung gi dbang bskur sngon tu thob pa la bya yi/ dbang bskur ma thob pa la bzlas lung mi 'bogs par gsungs so// da ni cho ga dngos bshad par bya ste/ gang bsod nams kyi tshogs chen po myur du rdzogs par 'dod pa dang*/ gang ye shes kyi tshogs bde blag tu 'grub par 'dod pa dang*/ gang zhig sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa dang mi 'bral bas rgyal ba'i zhal lta ba la ring ba dang*/ gang 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal las bde blag tu grol zhing rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod pa mtha' yas pa bsgrub par 'dod pa'i blo ldan dag ni tshul 'di la phyi bshol med par rtag tu 'jug par rigs te/ dwang ba dang 'dod pa dang yid ches pa'i dad pa gsum ni gnas dus yo byad rgyu rkyen gyi gtso bo nyid do// de bas gang mos pas spyod pa'i skabs de'am/ rgyal ba'i dus chen lta bur/ gnas khang gtsang zhing mdzes bar brgyan pa'i dbus su/

bsod nams brgya'i mtshan dang ldan pa'i rgyal ba'i sku bris 'bur gang yang rung ba mchod pa'i rten tu bzhugs su gsol zhing*/ ma 'byor na mos pas kyang khyab la/ dmigs pa'i rten tsam du byi dor byas pa'i maṇḍal dri bzang gi chag chag btab pa la rin po che'am 'bru'i tshom bu bkod pas kyang rung ba nyid do// de dag gi mdun tu mchod pa'i maṇḍal/ khrus kyi yo byad/ mchod yon zhabs bsil sngon du 'gro ba'i/ me tog bdug spos mar me'i phreng ba/ dri bzang gi yon chab/ zhal zas rol mo'i bye brag rnams dang*/ bkra shis rdzas rtags rin chen sna bdun sogs 'byor pas dpag pa rnams kyi yo byad re re la'ang brgya'am stong phrag sogs nus pa ma bsris pa bsham zhing*/ bla bre dang ba dan la sogs pa mchod pa'i yo byad sna tshogs pas gnas khang brgyan pa sogs bkod pa'i bye brag tshar du dngar ba bya/ gal te 'byor pa dman la mos pa dag gis ni ji ltar 'byor pa'i me tog gis mtshon/ lhag ma dmigs pas khyab par bya yi mtha' gcig tu spros pa'i ngos bzung med do// sta gon tu bya ba de tsam gyis grub nas/ cho ga'i las rim la 'jug pa na khrus dang gtsang sbra byas/ shes rab stong pa nyid dang*/ thabs snying rje chen pos kun la khyab par bltas te/ gang gis rten cing 'brel bar 'byung*// 'gag pa med pa skye med pa// chad pa med pa rtag med pa// 'ong ba med pa 'gro med pa// tha dad don min don gcig min// spros pa nyer zhi zhir bstan pa// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas smra rnams kyi// dam pa de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes dang*/ gang zhig brten nas skyes pa de ma skyes// de la skye ba'i rang bzhin yod ma yin// rkyen la rag las gang de stong pa ste// gang gis stong nyid shes de bag yod yin// zhes pa dag don dran bzhin tu brjod pas stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin ci nus su bsgom/ de las langs nas sems can thams cad kyi don du/

sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dam pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig ces tshad med pa bzhi bsgom zhing*/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa 'di dag gis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces pa lan gsum gyis byang chub kyi sems yid la byed/ bden pa dang mos pa tsam gyi stobs la brten nas de bzhin gshegs pa mchod pa'i gnas dang yo byad byin gyis brlab pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ byin rlabs dang*/ tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mthu dang*/ chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin gyi yon tan dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su sbyangs pa'i mthu dang*/ bdag cag rnams kyi mos pa'i mthu las gnas 'dir sa gzhi rin po che sna bdun pa'i rang bzhin lag mthil ltar mnyam pa tha gru che zhing yangs pa/ reg na 'jam zhing bde ba/ lha'i me tog dri zhim pos gcal bkram pa/ yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chu'i mtsho dang rdzing bu dang lteng ka rin po che'i phye ma gram bur bdal zhing nor bu'i pha gus brtsigs pa/ utpal dang ku mu ta dang padma du mas mdzes pa dang*/ chu bya skad snyan par sgrogs pa mang pos gang ba rnams dang*/ rin po che'i shing ljon pa sna tshogs rnam par rgyas pa la sogs la sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi rgyan dang bkod pa yon tan phun sum tshogs pa thams cad dang ldan par gyur cig lan gsum mam gcig de'i dbus su gzhal med khang chen po rin po che sna bdun mchog tu 'bar ba bkod pa/ 'jig rten kyi khams dpag tu med pa rgyas par 'gengs pa'i 'od zer chen po rab tu 'byung ba/

gnas tha dad pa shin tu rnam par phye ba mtha' yas pa rnam par gnas pa/ rgya yongs su ma chad pa khams gsum las yang dag par 'das pa'i spyod yul 'jig rten las yang dag par 'das pa de'i bla ma'i dge ba'i rtsa ba las byung ba/ shin tu rnam par dag cing dbang bsgyur ba'i rnam par rig pa'i mtshan nyid/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gnas byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang ldan pa/ lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang dri za dang lha ma yin dang nam mkha' lding dang mi'am ci dang lto 'phye chen po dang mi dang mi ma yin pa mtha' yas pa rnam par rgyu ba/ chos kyi ro yi dga' ba dang bde ba chen pos brten pa/ sems can thams cad kyi don thams cad yang dag par thob par byed pas nye bar gnas pa/ nyon mongs pa'i gnod pa'i dri ma thams cad dang bral ba/ bdud thams cad yongs su spangs pa/ thams cad kyi bkod pa las lhag pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i bkod pa'i gnas/ dran pa blo gros dang rtogs pa chen pos nges par 'byung ba zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gi bzhon pa yin pa/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang*/ mtshan ma med pa nyid dang*/ smon pa med pa nas 'jug pa/ rin po che padma'i rgyal po yon tan mtha' yas pas brgyan pa'i bkod pa la brten pa'i gzhal med khang chen por gyur/ de'i dbus su lha dang klu dang mi la sogs pa'i rin po che sna tshogs pa'i khri'i steng du lha mi'i gos rin thang med pa bting ba'i steng du/ gtsang zhing dri ma med pa'i padma'i gdan sna tshogs pa bshams pa so sor gsal bar gyur/ khri de dag gi steng du rin po che sna tshogs dang lha dang mi'i gos sna tshogs las grub pa'i gdugs dang bla re dang*/ 'phan dang lda ldi dang lha'i me tog mandā ra ba la sogs pa rnams kyi char dang*/ bla re dang gdugs dang 'phan dang*/ lda ldi la sogs pa mdzes par bres shing*/ logs rnams kyang rin po che dang*/ dar dang me tog la sogs pa'i drwa ba dang drwa phyed dang 'phan dang lda ldi la sogs pas mdzes pa dang*/

sa gzhir lha dang mi'i me tog sil ma bkram zhing*/ mchod yon me tog bdug spos mar me dri chab zhal zas rol mo la sogs pa phung po gsum pa'i mdo dang bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam las 'byung ba lta bu'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi rgya mtsho phul du byung zhing sna tshogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa nam mkha'i khams kyi mtha' klas par rgyas par gang zhing zad mi shes pa dang ldan par gyur/ de dag thun mong du byin gyis brlab pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ byin rlabs dang*/ tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mthu dang*/ chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin gyi yon tan dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su sbyangs pa'i mthu dang*/ bdag cag rnams kyi mos pa'i mthu las de de bzhin tu gyur cig lan gsum mam bsdu na tshar gcig bzlas/ snyan gsan dbab cing spyan 'dren pa ni dad pa chen pos pus btsugs thal mo sbyar te me tog bkram/ spos thogs la/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba/ kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag tu med pa/ sku tshe dpag tu med pa/ 'od kyi snang ba mtha' yas pa/ byang chub sems dpa' dang nyan thos kyi dge 'dun rgya mtsho lta bu'i 'khor gyis bskor ba/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas shing dam pa'i chos skyong ba'i zhabs 'bring gi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba thams cad/ bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi nyes ltung gi dri ma sbyong zhing bsod nams kyi tshogs spel ba'i slad du spyan 'dren zhing mchis na thugs rje chen pos bskul te deng dus la babs kyis dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru// 'gro la brtse phyir thugs rje rnam sbyangs shing*// smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa'i// khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags na// de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas// rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing*// mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir// yongs bdag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol// bde ba can gyi zhing khams nas sngon gyi thugs dam las brtsams te/

de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul chen pos nam mkha'i lam las mngon par gshegs te gzhal med khang gi dbus su byang chub kyi shing rnam par rgyas pa'i drung du seng ge'i khri chen po la de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med/ 'khor phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dam pa'i chos skyong ba rgya mtsho bcas mngon sum du bzhugs shing*/ thugs rje chen pos dgongs par gyur/ bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan// bdag gi mchod yon bzhes slad du// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// zhes dang*/ rin chen du ma las grub seng ge'i khri// yid 'phrog sna tshogs gos kyis bkab pa 'di// sangs rgyas sras dang bcas la phul ba yis// 'gro kun rdo rje'i gdan la 'khod par shog /stong gsum kun dang mnyam pa yi// padma 'dab brgyad ge sar bcas// bde zhing yangs par 'bul lags na// ci bde bar ni bzhugs su gsol// mchod yon gyi chu bzed zhal du sbrengs la/ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang*// sems can lus ngag yid gsum gdung ba sel slad du// yan lag brgyad ldan chu gtsang yid du 'ong ba 'di// bzhes shig bzhes shig bdag gi mchod yon 'di dag go /btung ba phul ba'i bsod nams kyis// nyon mongs bkres skom zhi ba dang*// sbyin sogs yon tan ldan pa yi// skom nad med par skye bar shog /chu dūrba'i chun pos blangs te chol zangs su zhabs bkru ba'i tshul bya zhing*/ ngang pa'i mchog ltar sor mo drwa bas 'brel/ 'khor lo'i mtshan can mdzes pa'i zhabs zung la// dag byed phul bas skye bo ma lus pa// rdzu 'phrul rkang pa mchog dang ldan gyur cig /khrus gsol ba ni/ phyag len mthong brgyud ltar byas la/ khrus kyi khang pa shin tu dri zhim pa// shel gyi sa gzhi gsal zhing 'tsher ba bstar// rin chen 'bar ba'i ka ba yid 'ong ldan// mu tig 'od chags bla re bres pa der// dri dang bcas pa'i 'dag chal dūrbas byug cing*/

stong gsum kun tu dri ngad ldang gyur pa'i// dri mchog rnams kyis thub dbang rnams kyi sku// gser sbyangs btso ma byi dor byas pa ltar// 'od chags 'bar ba de dag byug par bgyi// khrus gsol ba ni/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kun gyis khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan// thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med// byin rlabs ye shes chu yis ni// ci 'dod dngos grub stsal du gsol// de bzhin gshegs dang de yi sras rnams la// rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chus// yid 'ong legs par bkang ba glu dang ni// rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol// sku phyi zhing*/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la dri rab bgos pas sku phyi'o// gos zung ngur smrig 'bul zhing*/ de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i// na bza' shin tu dri zhim dam pa 'bul// gos bzang srab la 'jam pa sna tshogs dang*// rgyan mchog brgya phrag de dang de dag gis// 'phags pa kun tu bzang dang 'jam dbyangs dang*// 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs la'ang brgyan par bgyi// sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab bkra zhing*// gang la reg na bde ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'i// gos bzang rin chen bdag blo sbyang phyir 'bul// bzod pa dam pa'i gos kyis brgyan par shog /ces spyan 'dren yan lag bcas song nas/ tshogs bsags pa'i thog mar phyag 'tshal ba ni/ 'grengs te gnas lnga 'dud pa'i phyag bcas/ na mo mañdzu shrī ye/ na mo utta ma shrī ye/ na maḥsu shrī ye swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags lan gsum sngon du 'gro bas/ bla ma mnyam med sangs rgyas rin po che// dus gsum bde gshegs sras bcas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin byin brlabs pas// bka' drin chen po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na// dus gsum gshegs pa mi yi seng ge kun// bdag gis ma lus de dag thams cad la// lus dang ngag yid dang bas phyag bgyi'o// bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam stobs dag gis// rgyal ba thams cad yid kyis mngon sum du// zhing gi rdul snyed lus rab btud pa yis// rgyal ba kun la rab tu phyag 'tshal lo// rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed sangs rgyas rnams// sangs rgyas sras kyi dbus na bzhugs pa dag

/de ltar chos kyi dbyings rnams ma lus par// thams cad rgyal ba dag gis gang bar mos// de dag bsngags pa mi zad rgya mtsho rnams// dbyangs kyi yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgra kun gyis// rgyal ba kun gyi yon tan rab brjod cing*// bde bar gshegs pa thams cad bdag gis bstod// bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa// yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bla na med// tshe dang ye shes dpag med rnam nges pa// gzi brjid rgyal po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med// dus min 'chi ba ma lus 'joms mdzad cing*// mgon med sdug bsngal gyur pa rnams kyi skyabs// mgon po tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo// thabs mkhas thugs rjes shākya'i rigs su 'khrungs// gzhan gyis mi thub bdud kyi dpung 'joms pa// gser gyi lhun po lta bur brjid pa'i sku// shākya'i rgyal po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// mi 'khrugs pa dang lhun po'i rgyal mtshan dang*// lhun po lhun po chen po lhun chen snang*// 'jam sgra 'jam pa'i dbyangs sogs shar phyogs kyi// sangs rgyas dpag tu med la phyag 'tshal lo// nyi zla sgron ma grags pa grags pa'i 'od// 'od 'phro phung po lhun po'i sgron ma dang*// brtson 'grus mtha' yas la sogs lho phyogs kyi// sangs rgyas dpag tu med la phyag 'tshal lo// tshe dpag med dang phung po dpag med dang*// rgyal mtshan dpag med 'od chen 'od zer snang*// rin tog 'od zer dag sogs nub phyogs kyi// sangs rgyas dpag tu med la phyag 'tshal lo// 'od 'phro'i phung po chen po sgrol ba'i dbyangs// rab tu thul dka' nyi 'byung drwa can 'od// 'od kyi 'byung gnas la sogs byang phyogs kyi// sangs rgyas dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo// bde gshegs seng ge dang ni grags pa'i mtshan// grags 'od chos dang chos 'dzin ces bya dang*// chos kyi rgyal mtshan la sogs 'og phyogs kyi// sangs rgyas dpag tu med la phyag 'tshal lo// tshangs dbyangs skal rgyal spos mchog spos kyi 'od// spos phung me tog shin tu rgyas pa'i rigs// swa la'i dbang rgyal rin chen utpal 'dab// mthong ba don yod ri rab lta bu sogs// steng phyogs sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// ma rig mun sel sgron me'i mchog

/sdug bsngal nad sel sman gyi phul// dam chos dkon mchog thams cad la// phyag 'tshal mchod cing skyabs su mchi// 'jam dbyangs phyag na rdo rje spyan ras gzigs// sa yi snying po sgrib pa rnam par sel// nam mkha' snying po byams pa kun tu bzang*// nye ba'i sras chen brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo// bsod nams zhing rab mchog gyur pa// lha dang mi yi mchod pa'i gnas// rgyal sras rang rgyal dgra bcom pa// tshogs mchog dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal// phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba ma lus dang*// byang chub sems dang rgyal sras ma lus tshogs// rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed bzhugs pa yi// bla med 'phags pa'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// rdzogs sangs gang du bltams pa dang*// gang du byang chub la reg dang*// zhi ba'i 'khor lo bskor ba dang*// zag med mya ngan 'das pa dang*// bde gshegs gang du bzhugs pa dang*// 'chags pa dang ni bzhengs pa dang*// seng ge lta bur gzims pa yi// gnas de la yang phyag 'tshal lo// steng dang 'og dang bar dag dang*// phyogs dang phyogs mtshams rnams su yang*// skur bcas skur ni med pa yi// mchod rten rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi// lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu// mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo// de nas mchod pa la sogs pa'i yan lag lhag ma rnams kyi thog mar maṇḍal rgyas par phul la yongs su bsngo ba'i 'khor lo'i mdo las byung ba 'di don dran bzhin bklag par bya ste/ bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag tu med pa la sogs pa/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad dang*/ sa bcu la rab tu gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams dang*/ rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yang dag pa'i lam la bde bar gnas pa ma thob pas deng byang chub tu sems bskyed de/

bdag gi lus dang sems 'di dus thams cad dang*/ rnam pa thams cad du dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la bdag gi lus 'bul gyis/ mthu chen po mnga' ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang*/ sa chen po la rab tu gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bdag bzhes su gsol/ bdag gi bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs chen po dang*/ brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang*/ sems kyi rgya bskyed pa dang*/ rab tu zhi zhing dul ba dang*/ dbang dang*/ mngon par shes pa dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa la sogs pa myur du yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig yang bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi 'khor ba na 'khor zhing bcing ba chen pos bcings par gyur pa/ btson ra na gnas pa/ yang dag pa'i lam dang bral ba/ nyon mongs pa'i dgra'i dbang du gyur pa/ mgon med pa/ skyabs med pa/ mig med pa/ rten med pa/ gtso bo med pa/ 'dren pa med par gyur pa/ lam gol bar song ba/ 'khor ba la gzhol ba/ mya ngan las 'das pa chen po la rgyab kyis phyogs pa/ ngan 'gro la phyogs pa/ lam ngan pa la bsten pa/ lam ngan par lhung bar gyur pa/ rtag tu bshes gnyen ngan pas zin cing dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang bral ba/ yang dag pa dang yang dag pa ma yin pa dang*/ phan par 'gyur ba dang*/ phan pa med pa dang*/ don yod pa dang don med pa la rmongs par gyur pa/ dge ba'i chos dang bral zhing mi dge ba chen po bsgrubs pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i 'phags pa rnams la rtag tu rgyab kyis phyogs pa/ skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal gyis gzir cing mi bde ba chen po bsgrubs pa/ 'jigs pa med pa/ bag tsha ba med pa/ sems rtag tu yengs par gyur pa/ sbyin pa dang*/ tshul khrims dang*/ zhi zhing dben pa dang*/ sgrub pa dang*/ bag yod pa dang bral bar gyur pa/ gzungs dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo dang*/

sa bcu'i chos kyi bzod pa la bde bar gnas pa dang*/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo dang mnyam pa nyid las ring du gyur pa/ byams pa dang*/ snying rje dang*/ dga' ba dang*/ btang snyoms tshad med pa bzhi mi sgrub pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i lhag pa'i tshul khrims dang mi ldan par gyur pa dang chags pa med pa dang*/ thogs pa med pa'i ye shes chen po las ring du gyur pa dang*/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i rgyu dge ba'i chos sgrub pa la bde bar gnas pa ma thob pa dang*/ rdzu 'phrul dang*/ stobs dang*/ mi 'jigs pa dang bral bar gyur pa dang*/ yang dag pa'i dran pa la mi gnas pa dang*/ bsnyel ba mi mnga' ba'i chos nyid la spyod cing gzhol bar 'jug pa mi 'grub pa dang*/ bsod nams byed pa la g.yel zhing lta ba snyems pa dang the tshom gyi sgrib pas byang chub kyi yan lag bdun mngon par mi rtogs pa dang*/ de bzhin du 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad mi sgrub pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa brgya stong tshad med pas zil gyis non cing sdug bsngal rnam pa mang pos sdug bsngal zhing yongs su mnar te/ rtag tu gdung ba bsam pa zhan pas khro zhing rtag tu g.yeng ba/ nyon mongs pa brgya stong la rgyun gzhol bar gyur pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i thugs rje chen po la gnas pa rnams kyis bdag gi skyabs mdzad par gsol/ bdag gi rten mdzad par gsol/ bdag gi 'dren par mdzad par gsol/ bdag myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi lam dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i lam dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i tshogs sogs pa yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig bdag myur du de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang*/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos spobs pa thogs pa med pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ gzungs dang*/ rnam par grol ba'i yon tan dang*/

rdzu 'phrul dang*/ mngon par shes pa dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig bdag bsod nams phun sum tshogs pa thams cad dang ldan par gyur cig mchod pa'i sprin 'byung ba'i gzungs sngags ni/ na mo bha ga wa te badzra sā ra pra mardha ni/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arha te samyaksaṃ buddhā ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ badzre badzre ma hā badzre/ ma hā te dzo badzre/ ma hā bidyā badzre/ mahā bo dhi tsitta badzre/ ma hā bo dhi maṇḍo pa saṃ kra ma ṇa badzre/ sarba karma ā ba ra ṇa bi sho dha na badzre swā hā/ lan gsum/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mthu chen po mnga' ba thams cad dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ deng bdag sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la mchod pa dang*/ rim gro chen po bgyis te lus 'bul lo// phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na ji snyed rgyan dang*/ yo byad bzang po thams cad rin po che'i gzhal med khang pa rnam pa sna tshogs pa dang*/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad dang*/ rin po che'i shing dang*/ rin po che'i ri dang*/ rin po che'i ba dan dang*/ rin po che'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ rin po che'i dbyig rnam par bkra ba dang*/ rin po che'i gdugs dang*/ rin po che'i rgyal mtshan dang*/ rin po che'i do shal gyi rgyan dang*/ mu tig gi drwa ba dang*/ rin po che'i snod dang*/ rin po che'i phung po dang*/ rin po che 'od 'phro ba dang*/ rin po che'i gling dag nas nor bu rin po che chen po rnam par dag pa'i mar me'i sdong bu dang*/ rin po che'i dril bu'i sgra 'khrol ba la nor bu rin po che 'od 'phro ba gser btso ma'i spar khab can gyi dom dom po long dpyangs pas yongs su khebs pa/ gser btso ma'i me tog 'dzam bu'i gser gyi ze ba can/ gser gyi shing ljon pas dkris pa/ gser gyi pho brang sna tshogs rin po che'i sprin chags pa/ rin po che'i thigs pa char du 'bab pa/

rin po che rnam pa mang po'i mdzod kyi pho brang*/ lha rdzas kyi nor bu'i rtsig ngos spras pa/ rin po che'i shing thams cad rig 'dzin chen po'i skyed mos tshal gyi rwa ba yid du 'ong ba/ rin po che'i pho brang dang*/ gnas dang*/ shing dang*/ nags tshal la sogs pa thams cad kyang yid du 'ong ba de lta bu bdag po med pa 'dzin pa med pa thams cad sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la yongs su bsngo zhing 'bul lo// 'dzam bu'i gling na sman bzang po ring du 'tsho bar byed pa la sogs pa'i rnam pa ji snyed yod pa dang*/ nor bu rin po ches sems can thams cad kyi re ba yongs su skong ba dang*/ ma g.yos par rang bzhin gyis bda' ba'i zhal zas bzang po dang*/ spos kyi shing ljon pa rnam pa sna tshogs pa dang*/ tsandan gyi shing dang*/ a ga ru dang*/ tsandan dmar po dang*/ lo ma che zhing me tog rtag par bsung gis gzi bar byed pa'i shing rnam pa sna tshogs dang*/ yid du 'ong ba'i lha rdzas kyi spos ma bzung ba yongs su ma bzung ba dang*/ dpag bsam gyi shing rnam pa sna tshogs pa dang*/ rgya mtsho chen po'i nang nas 'byung ba nor bu rin po che rnam pa sna tshogs yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che la sogs pa dang*/ ri rab lhun po dang*/ ri ti se dang*/ spos kyi ri dang*/ ri ma la ya dang*/ ri btang bzung dang*/ ri ma ha la dang*/ rdo rje'i ri la sogs te ri chen po rnam pa de dag gis rin po che'i zom sna tshogs dang*/ rin po che'i stegs dang*/ rdo pa rin po che dang*/ rin po che'i phug dang*/ rin po che'i pho brang dang*/ rin po che'i rgyun dang*/ rin po che'i zhogs ma dang*/ rin po che'i lam srang mang po dang*/ nor bu rin po che'i ka ba mang po dang*/ rin po che'i sgron me'i 'khor lo mang po dang*/ bai ḍūrya la sogs te nor bu'i rigs rnam pa mang po dang*/ ji tsam du gnam gyi steng na bdag po med pa'i lha'i pho brang lha'i nor rnam pa mang po yid du 'ong zhing blta bar 'os pa dang*/

lha'i rol mo'i yo byad rnam pa mang po rlung gi ngad kyis bskyod pa tsam gyi sgra snyan par 'byin pa dang*/ nam mkha' la gnas pa'i pho brang nas rol mo'i sgra snyan par 'byin pa dang*/ lha'i rol mo rnam pa mang po ma bskyod par sgra snyan par 'byin pa dang*/ lha'i bya sna tshogs nam mkha'i pho brang nas snyan pa'i sgra sna tshogs 'byin pa dang*/ rin po che'i sprin sna tshogs las sgra snyan pa chen por 'byung ba dang*/ lha'i nor bu rin po che'i dbyangs snyan pa'i sgra sgrogs pa dang*/ gzhan yang lha'i dri'i shing dang*/ me tog gi shing mang po dang*/ phreng ba'i shing dang*/ byug pa mang po dang*/ bdug pa'i spos kyi shing dang*/ sgron me'i shing dang*/ rgyal mtshan gyi shing dang*/ ba dan gyi shing dang*/ rin po che'i shing la sogs pa de dag thams cad ma bzung ba yongs su ma bzung ba de dag thams cad kyang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la dbul lo// ji tsam du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi spyan gyis gzigs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing dag na mchod pa'i sprin chen po me tog gi sprin dang*/ spos kyi sprin dang*/ phreng ba'i sprin dang*/ bdug spos kyi sprin dang*/ byug spos kyi sprin dang*/ rin po che'i gdugs kyi sprin dang*/ rin po che'i rgyal mtshan gyi sprin dang*/ rin po che'i ba dan gyi sprin dang*/ rin po che'i gos kyi sprin dang*/ rin po che'i rnam pa'i sprin dang*/ rin po che'i phung po'i sprin la sogs te/ rin po che chen po'i sprin rnam pa de dag dang*/ gzhan yang spos kyi 'bru mar gyis mar me'i snod chen po bkang ba stong gi 'jig rten gyi tshad dang mnyam pa/ mar me'i snying po ri rab kyi tshad tsam pa sgron mar byas te sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag thams cad dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams la mchod cing dbul lo// de bzhin du mchod pa rnam pa sna tshogs kyis mchod pa'i bsod nams dam pa ji tsam pa de dag thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo'o// gang 'das pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis dge ba mang po brtsams te/

dmigs su med pa'i tshul gyis byang chub tu yongs su bsngos pa de bzhin tu bdag gis kyang bsod nams de dag thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo'o// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das byang chub kyi snying por mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas chos kyi 'khor lo chen po ni bskor/ bdud kyi sde rnams ni pham par byas nas mya ngan las 'da' bar gshegs par dgongs pa la sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir bskal pa chen po gcig tshang bar bzhugs par gsol lo// sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ sems can thams cad kyis bsod nams ci bsgrubs pa de dag thams cad la rjes su yi rang ngo*// dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis sdig pa dang mi dge ba'i las kyi sgrib pa thams cad bshags pa de bzhin tu bdag gis kyang yongs su bshags shing yongs su sbyong ngo*// zhes brjod la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mngon sum du dmigs pa'i spyan sngar gsang sngags 'di lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzla'o// oṃ sambha ra sambha ra bhi ma na sa ra/ ma hā dzā bā hūm̐/ de nas/ me tog dam pa phreng ba dam pa dang*// sil snyan rnams dang byug pa gdugs mchog dang*// mar me mchog dang bdug spos dam pa yis// rgyal ba de dag la ni mchod par bgyi// na bza' dam pa rnams dang dri mchog dang*// phye ma'i phur ma ri rab mnyam pa dang*// bkod pa khyad par 'phags pa'i mchog kun gyis// rgyal ba de dag la yang mchod par bgyi// mchod pa gang rnams bla med rgya che ba// de dag rgyal ba thams cad la yang mos// bzang po spyod la dad pa'i stobs dag gis// rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyi// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dbang gis ni// lus dang ngag dang de bzhin yid kyis kyang*// sdig pa bdag gis bgyis pa ci mchis pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis so sor bshags// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun dang sangs rgyas sras// rang rgyal rnams dang slob dang mi slob dang*// 'gro ba kun gyi bsod nams gang la yang*// de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag yi rang*// gang rnams phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten sgron ma dag

/byang chub rim pa sangs rgyas ma chags brnyes// mgon po de dag bdag gis thams cad la// 'khor lo bla na med pa bskor bar bskul// mya ngan 'da' ston gang bzhed de dag la// 'gro ba kun la phan zhing bde ba'i phyir// bskal pa zhing gi rdul snyed bzhugs par yang*// bdag gis thal mo rab sbyar gsol bar bgyi// phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang*/ rjes su yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba yi// dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa// thams cad bdag gis byang chub phyir bsngo'o// zhes dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med pa la sogs pa/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa spyan drangs te phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ mchod cing sdig pa bshags pa dang*/ dge ba la rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul zhing mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba btab pa dang*/ de dag gi mthu dpal dang byin gyi rlabs kyi stobs kyis bdag cag gi thog ma ma mchis pa'i 'khor ba nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur cig lus la nad med pa dang tshe ring bar gyur cig 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i go 'phang mchog brnyes par gyur cig yul khams thams cad du'ang mi nad dang phyugs nad dang lo nyes pa dang dgra'i gnod pa la sogs pa bkra mi shis pa'i bag ci yang mi 'byung bar gyur cig char chu dus su babs te lo phyugs 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang*/ bde skyid kyi dpal phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur cig sems can thams cad kyang bde ba dang ldan sdug bsngal dang bral te tshogs gnyis rdzogs te sangs rgyas par gyur cig khyad par du bdag dang pha ma sbyin pa'i bdag pos gtsor byas bzang ngan gyi 'brel pas bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad tshe 'di 'phos ma thag par srid pa gzhan du nying mtshams mi sbyor bar sangs rgyas kyi zhing bde ba can tu brdzus te skyes nas/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag tu med pa la dam pa'i chos mnyan cing byang chub kyi spyod pa yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig

de nas spro zhing nus na shing rta chen po'i lugs gnyis dang 'brel ba'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa rgyas pa blang*/ mdor bsdu na/ byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// sogs lan gsum/ ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyis// sogs lan gsum gyis skyabs gsum sngon du 'gro ba'i smon 'jug gi sems bzung la/ deng dus bdag tshe sogs mjug gi cho ga'ang brjod do// slar yang khyad par du mchod cing smon lam gdab pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do skyabs su mchi'o// bdun nam nyer gcig brgya rtsa skabs bstun brjod cing*/ nus na phyag 'tshal ba'i gzungs sngon tu 'gro bas dngos su phyag bya'o// byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do skyabs su mchi'o// byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mthu chen thob pa la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do skyabs su mchi'o// gsum re'am bdun brjod/ 'phags pa'i tshogs de dag thams cad la mchod yon dang byug pa/ me tog dang bdug spos/ mar me dang zhal zas/ rol mo dang sil snyan/ gdugs dang ba dan la sogs pa dngos su ci 'byor pa 'di dag dang phyogs bcu na bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i lha dang mi'i rdzas dam pa bde ba'i yo byad phun sum tshogs pa thams cad dang gzungs dang rig pa'i mthu dang mos pa'i stobs kyis bskyed pa'i mchod pa'i sprin bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam las 'byung ba rgya mtsho thams cad kyis nam mkha'i khams kyi mtha' klas pa thams cad rgyas par bkang ste/ 'bul lo mchod do// che ge zhes bya ba dang*/ bdag cag gis thog ma ma mchis pa nas 'khor ba na 'khor ba'i tshe rabs thams cad du sdig pa mi dge ba'i las mdor na mi bgyi bar rigs pa'i las ni bgyis/ bgyi bar 'os pa'i las ni ma bgyis pa la sogs pa dngos sdig ci mchis pa thams cad yang dag par 'chags so// dus gsum gyi 'phags pa dang skye bo'i dge ba mtha' dag gi bsod nams thams cad la rjes su yi rang ngo*// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad la chos kyi 'khor lo bla na med par bskor bar bskul lo// 'jig rten gyi sgron me gang dang mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul ston par bzhed pa de dag thams cad la mya ngan las mi 'da' bar 'jig rten gyi don mdzad cing yun ring du bzhugs par gsol bar 'tshal lo// deng rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i tshogs gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med sras dang bcas pa'i mtshan nas brjod cing phyag 'tshal te mchod pa la sogs pa'i mthus/

de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med sras dang bcas pa'i sngon gyi smon lam dang byang chub kyi spyod pa khyad par can dang mthun par bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag deng nas byang chub kyi snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ lan 'ga' yang 'dod pa dang*/ gnod sems dang*/ rnam par 'tshe ba'i rnam rtog dang*/ 'dod pa'i yon tan gyi rtog pa dang 'du shes mi skye bar gyur cig des shing 'grogs na bde ba dang 'dod pa chung zhing chog shes pa dang*/ g.yo dang sgyu med pa dang*/ ngang tshul bzang zhing snyan par smra bas dkar po'i chos yongs su tshol ba la rtag tu brtson par gyur cig dkon mchog gsum dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen la gus pa dang bcas shing*/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la rtag tu go cha bgos te thams cad dge ba'i chos yang dag par 'dzin tu 'jug pa dang*/ rnam par thar pa'i gnas la gnas par gyur cig nga rgyal med cing ngag legs par bsrungs te rang gzhan la gnod par 'gyur ba spang*/ phan par 'gyur ba sgrub cing shes bzhin dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig bdag nyid kyang pha rol tu phyin pa drug la spyod cing gzhan dag kyang de nyid yang dag par 'dzin tu 'jug par gyur cig gang dang gang du skyes pa de dang der gter bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma sa las 'byung ba dang*/ sems can bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong grangs med dpag tu med pa bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la 'god pa dang*/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das grangs med dpag tu med pa la mchod pa'i bye brag mtha' yas pas mchod cing rim gror bya ba dang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor bar bskul zhing mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba 'debs par gyur cig skye ba thams cad du kha nas tsandan gyi dri dang*/ ba spu'i khung bu nas utpa la'i bsung 'byung zhing*/ mtshan dang dpe byad bzang pos lus legs par brgyan cing*/ rgyan gos dang zas skom dang glu dbyangs la sogs pa yongs su spyad pa ji 'dod pa thams cad ba spu'i khung bu dang lag pa'i mthil nas 'jig rten las khyad par 'phags pa kho na 'byung bar gyur cig

bdag cag la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su rdzogs shing*/ rgyal ba rnams la lhag par bya ba byas te/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gyis brlabs kyis myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig gang du 'tshang rgya ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing de na sems can dmyal ba dang*/ dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang*/ yi dwags kyi yul dang lha ma yin gyi gnas ris dang der ltung ba'i ming tsam yang med par gyur cig sangs rgyas kyi zhing der skyes pa'i sems can thams cad gser gyi mdog tu gcig cing lha dang mi'i yon tan tha dad med par sems kyi skad cig thang cig la/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong 'da' ba'i rdzu 'phrul gyi dbang dam pa thob pa dang*/ tshe rabs dpag tu med pa dran pa dang*/ 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong mthong ba'i lha'i mig dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du gcig car chos nyan pa'i lha'i rna ba dang*/ sems can de snyed kyi spyod pa yongs su 'tshal ba'i mngon shes dang ldan par gyur cig rang gi lus la yongs su 'dzin pa'i 'du shes mi 'byung zhing*/ yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po'i bar yang dag pa nyid la nges par gyur cig sangs rgyas kyi zhing de na nyan thos 'dus pa tshad ma mchis pa dang*/ sems can rnams la mi dge ba'i ming yang mi grags shing*/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po bgos pa sha stag tu gyur nas/ smon lam gyi dbang ma gtogs par tshe'i tshad la tshad med cing skye ba gcig gis thogs pa dang*/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang ldan par gyur cig bdag gi lus las phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing tshad med pa khyab pa'i 'od 'byung zhing 'od thams cad kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ 'od des khyab pa'i sems can thams cad lha dang mi las 'das pa'i bde ba dang ldan pa dang*/

sku tshe'i tshad bskal pa grangs med dpag tu med par 'tsho zhing gzhes te/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing mtha' yas pa dag gi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das grangs med dpag tu ma mchis pa rnams kyis bsngags pa mdzad par gyur cig sems can gang dag 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan dag tu bla na med par yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed nas/ bdag gi ming thos te sems rab tu dang bar gyur la bdag rjes su dran pa de dag gal te 'gum pa'i dus nye bar gnas pa'i tshe/ bdag dge slong gi dge 'dun gyis yongs su bskor cing mdun du bdar ba'i mdun tu g.yeng ba ma mchis pa'i sems kyis gnas te bdag gi zhing du 'dren par gyur cig sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med dpag tu med pa dag na sems can gang dag gis bdag gi ming thos nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing der skye bar bgyi pa'i slad du sems gtong zhing dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams kyang yongs su bsngo ba bgyid na/ mtshams med pa lnga dang*/ dam pa'i chos spong ba rnams ma gtogs pa/ tha na sems bskyed pa'i 'gyur ba bcus sangs rgyas kyi zhing der skye ba 'dzin par gyur cig sangs rgyas kyi zhing der skyes pa'i sems can de dag snga dro re bzhin sangs rgyas kyi zhing gzhan tu sangs rgyas dpag tu med pa mchod cing bsnyen bkur ba dang*/ rin po che dang rgyan dang rol mo glu dbyangs la sogs pa sems bskyed ma thag tu 'byung ba dang*/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i chos kyi bka' mchid gleng ba dang*/ sems bskyed ma thag tu zhing gzhan na bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis mchod pa bzhes shing thugs brtse bas dgongs par gyur cig sems can de dag sred med kyi bu dang rdo rje ltar mkhregs pa'i lus dang mthu thob pa dang*/ lung nod cing kha ton bgyi ba thams cad so sor yang dag par rig pa thob pa dang*/ sems can de dag skyes ma thag tu shes rab dang spobs pa mtha' yas pa thob pa dang*/

bde ba tshad med pa thob pa dang*/ sems bskyed ma thag tu chos gos rin po che de bzhin gshegs pas gnang ba bgo bar 'tshal ba dang*/ sems bskyed ma thag tu ji ltar 'dod pa'i chas thob par gyur cig sangs rgyas kyi zhing de'i gzi brjid kha dog 'byor ba'i khyad par mtha' yas pa dang*/ zhing de'i byang chub sems dpa' dge rtsa chung ba des kyang byang chub kyi shing dpag tshad stong phrag drug brgya tsam du mtho bar 'tshal ba dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing tshad ma mchis pa zhing der snang ba'i 'od gsal ba dang*/ lha dang mi las 'das pa'i bdug spos dang me tog gi char 'bab cing rol mo'i sgra dbyangs yid du 'ong ba'i sprin rtag tu 'byung ba dang*/ der skyes pa rnams kyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rgyan bkod pa ji ltar 'dod pa de dag rin po che'i shing sna tshogs las 'phyang ste 'byung bar gyur cig kun tu sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams su sems can rnams kyis bdag gi ming thos par gyur cig thos pa tsam gyis byang chub snying po'i mtha'i bar du gzungs thob cing ma nyams pa'i tshangs par spyod pa la gnas pa dang*/ dbang po ma tshang bar mi 'gyur ba dang*/ rigs bzang po'i rigs su skye ba thob cing byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dga' ba dang*/ mchog tu dga' ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dang phrad par gyur cig bud med gang dag bdag gi ming thos pa tsam gyis bud med kyi lus spangs te byang chub kyi snying po'i bar du skyes pa'i dbang po thob par gyur cig bdag gi ming thos nas phyag 'tshal ba de dag byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa spyod cing lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis bsti stang byed par gyur cig bdag gi ming thos ma thag tu shin tu rnam par phye ba dang kun gyi rjes su song ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob cing*/ thob ma thag tu phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa dpag tu med pa mthong zhing bsti stang bgyi ba dang*/

ting nge 'dzin de byang chub snying po'i bar du chud mi 'dza' bar gyur cig sems can gang dag bdag gi ming thos pa tsam gyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa dang*/ bzod pa mchog thob ste sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams las phyir mi ldog par gyur cig mdor na de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med dang*/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang mthu chen thob pa la sogs pa sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa rnams kyis byang chub tu thugs bskyed cing smon lam chen po ji ltar mdzad pa de dag ma lus shing lus pa med pa bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyis 'grub par gyur cig 'di nas shi 'phos nas kyang de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing bde ba can du padma'i snying po seng ge'i khri la brdzus te skye zhing*/ skyes ma thag tu gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa yon tan gyi tshogs mngon du gyur te ston pa bla na med pa 'od dpag tu med pa la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad las bka' lung yang dag par nod/ thugs mnyes par byed cing skad cig skad cig la sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du thogs pa med par 'jug par gyur cig ces dang*/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang phyogs bcu yi// zhes sogs bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam snying thag pa nas btab bo// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub kyi shing dang 'khor gyi tshogs dang bcas pa yid la byed cing yun ring du mnyam par bzhag mthar de las 'od zer gyi tshogs mtha' yas pa byung*/ bdag gzhan sems can thams cad la phog sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo du ma skyes/ bde ba can du skye zhing sangs rgyas 'od dpag med mjal ba'i skal ba can tu byas par mos la/ de bzhin

yongs su bsngo ba'i rgyal po las byung gshegs pa 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ tatya thā/ padme padma ni/ padma lo tsa ni/ padma saṃ bha be swā hā/ zhes dang*/ na mo yongs su bsngo ba dang*/ snang ba mtha' yas rjes su dran pa sogs gzungs mdo 'ga' zhig las phal cher mthun par byung*/ ratna tra yā ya/ na mo bha ga ba te/ a mi ta bhā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arha te samyaksambuddhā ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ a mi te/ a mi todbha we/ a mi ta saṃ bha we/ a mi ta bi krānte/ a mi ta gā mi nī/ ga ga na kīrti/ ka re sarba kle sha kṣa yaṃ ka ri swā hā/ brgya'am nyer gcig bzla/ rjes kyi bya bar phyag mchod rgyas par 'bul zhing yan lag lhag ma dang bcas pa'i zhar byung bde ba can du smon lam gdab pa ni/ phyogs bcu mtha' yas pa na shes bya'i don ma lus par khyab pa'i blo mnga' ba phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho rnyed la phyag 'tshal lo// sems kyi rnyogs ma yid gnyis bsal nas dang por ni/ shākya'i rgyal po thub la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// bde ba can na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba 'od dpag med// bla ma la yang dga' dang gus pas gdung bar bgyi// gang zhig phyogs kun dag na da ltar byung ba yi// 'gro la byams pa'i sangs rgyas nges par bzhugs rnams dang*// 'das dang phyis 'byung ba yi rgyal ba thams cad la// bdag ni dga' ba'i yid kyis yang dag mchod par bgyi// zhes dang*/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs brjod cing rol mo dbul/ thal mo sbyar ba dang bcas te/ yon tan rgya mtsho dpag med pa// sangs rgyas dam chos 'phags pa yi// dge 'dun dus gsum bzhugs pa rnams// ma lus pa la skyabs su mchi// mi dge thams cad bshags par bgyi// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// chos kyi 'khor lo rab bskor bar// rdzogs sangs rgyas la bskul ma 'tshal// kun mkhyen spyan gyis gzigs pa yi// bdag dge chung ngu gang mchis pa// des ni gtan du bral ba dag

/thams cad nye bar zhi gyur cig /rnam pa kun mchog ldan pa yi// stong pa shes pa'i ting nge 'dzin// byang chub bar gyi tshe rab tu// rtag tu bde dang ldan par shog /rnam par mi rtog lhun gyis grub// rtag tu mnyam par bzhag gyur cig /zla nyi nor bu rol mo ltar// sems can don la 'jug par shog /ji ltar rgyal ba mkhas pa rnams// shes rab pha rol phyin thabs bsngo// de ltar bdag gis dkar po rnams// byang chub tu ni bsngo bar bgyi// dkon mchog gsum la dmigs pa yi// bdag gi lus ngag yid dge dang*// sbyin pa tshul khrims bzod brtson 'grus// bsam gtan shes rab las byung gang*// de dag kun gyis bdag nyid ni// tshangs par spyod pa ldan pa dang*// 'jig rten mgon gyi bstan pa la// rab byung mngon dga' dbang ldan zhing*// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung rab kyi// gzhung don tshig la mkhas gyur nas// dam chos yongs su 'dzin pa dang*// lus dang srog la dga' med shog /bdag ni 'gum pa'i dus bgyid tshe// phyin ci ma log yid kyis su// sangs rgyas tshe dpag med mthong nas// 'di nas bde ba can du mchi// bdud kyi spyod yul mngon gyur tshe// drang srong chen po tshe dpag med// rtag tu ston pa mdzad gyur cing*// sa bcu thob nas de dag gi /rnam thar dag ni rim pa yis// byang chub dam pa thob par shog /sangs rgyas kun tu bzang po nyid thob nas// bag chags bcas pa nyes bsags rtsa nas bton// ye shes sgrib med snying rjer ldan nas su// 'gro ba rnams la sman dang bde bar bgyi// zhes yongs su bsngo ba'i rgyal po'i mdo las byung ba tsam mam/ spro na/ maṅga laṃ swa sti bha bantu/ shes bya thams cad mngon sum gzigs pa po// mchog gi yon tan ma lus mthar phyin pa'i// zla med brnyes pa de dang dam pa'i chos// byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs la gus phyag 'tshal// mtha' yas nam mkha'i mtha' klas zhing rgya mtsho// mtha' dag sku yi sprul pas snang bar mdzad// mtha' yas 'od mnga' thub chen tshe dpag med// mtha' med 'khor ba'i 'gro ba kun la khyab// kun mkhyen rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs rje'i 'od// kun nas rab rdzogs ye shes 'od 'phro bas// kun rtog srid pa'i mun stug sna tshogs pa// kun sel rnam 'dren gtso la phyag 'tshal lo// 'od phreng gsal bas zhing kun khyab mdzad de// ye shes spyan gyis cung zad gzigs pas kyang*// bdud sde'i dpung tshogs ma lus zhi mdzad pa// dpag med sku yi 'od la phyag 'tshal lo// srid dang zhi ba rab spangs rnam grol sku// ngo bo nyid kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// gang gang 'dul ba de la der ston pa'i// mtshan dang dpe byad kyis 'bar phyag 'tshal lo// chos kun rnam 'byed yan lag drug cu yi// gsung gcig gis kyang phyogs dus thams cad du// sems can dbang po'i rim pa ji bzhin 'jug

/dpag med gsung gi 'od la phyag 'tshal lo// smra bsam brjod pa'i yul las rab 'das kyang*// 'bad med lhun gyis grub pa'i yang dag tshig /gsum gi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pas// legs pa'i lam mchog ston la phyag 'tshal lo// rang bzhin 'od gsal mkha' ltar mi dmigs kyang*// rnam pa kun ldan ye shes rol pa yis// shes bya ji snyed mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas// dpag med thugs kyi 'od la phyag 'tshal lo// chos kun ngo bo nyid kyis nyer zhi zhing*// ma 'gags snang ba rab tu bkra ba gang*// khyod kyi gzigs pa'ang rnam dag zhi ba dang*// de bzhin kun tu gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo// gang zhig 'gro ba'i yid bzhin nyer 'tsho'i gnas// sku gsung thugs dang ye shes dpag med stobs// thugs rje 'phrin las dpag tu med pa yi// 'od dpag med la rtag par phyag 'tshal lo// dngos dang yid kyis sprul pa'i lus longs spyod// yongs su ma bzung nam mkha'i mthar thug pa// blo yis blangs te bde bar gshegs rnams mchod// dman la brtser dgongs bdag gi 'di dag bzhes// bdag dang sems can kun gyi sdig pa'i las// nyes par gyur gang mthol zhing bshags par bgyi// slan chad nam yang bgyid par ma gyur cig /las kyi sgrib pa'ang gtan tu zad byed shog /rgyal dang rgyal sras nyan thos rang rgyal dang*// 'gro ba kun gyi dge la rjes yi rang*// gang yang phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs thams cad la// theg mchog chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul// bskal pa rgya mtsho dpag tu med par yang*// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs// dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba ci yod pa// gzhan phan don phyir byang chub chen por bsngo// ji srid byang chub snying po ma thob bar// skye ba 'di dang ma 'ongs thams cad du// bla ma dam pas rjes su 'dzin gyur cig /byang chub sems ni nam du'ang nyams ma gyur// rigs gzugs longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa yi// dal 'byor mchog thob chos ldan grogs dang bcas// sangs rgyas bstan la rim bzhin slob pa dang*// 'dun dang brtson 'grus bag yod ldan gyur cig

/ngan song gsum sogs mi bzad 'khor ba yi// mi khom 'jig rten rnams su skye 'gyur las// gang de tshe 'di nyid la rab smin nas// lan grangs gzhan du myong bar ma gyur cig /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod dang brtson 'grus dang*// bsam gtan shes rab thabs mkhas rmad byung dang*// smon lam stobs dang ye shes rgya mtsho yi// spyod pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs gyur cig /lus dang de bzhin srog la'ang ltos med par// sems las rung zhing dben par rang rgyud dul// lung dang mngon par rtogs pa'i chos kyis 'byor// brtse ldan rtag tu shes bzhin ldan gyur cig /'khor ba'i de bzhin nyid gang mya ngan 'das// kun rtog de bzhin nyid gang ye shes te// gcig dang du ma'i bdag nyid las 'das pa'i// chos nyid rtogs pa'i blo gros ldan gyur cig /gang yang rten 'byung zab mo'i tshul gnas pa// des don mthar thug spros bral chos kyi sku// stobs sogs yon tan ye shes phrin las sogs// bde gshegs chos la thogs med 'jug gyur cig /gang du 'gro blo mngon par dga' gyur pa'i// yid lus spyod pa rnam par dag pa dang*// dbyangs snyan ngag gis chos tshul rgya mtsho ston// rgyal sras rnams kyi spyod dang mtshungs par shog /ji srid de lta'i yon tan ma thob bar// mi mthun phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba yi// 'chi med tshe dang dpal 'byor rgyas pa dang*// bsam pa'i don kun yid bzhin 'grub gyur cig /tshe 'di'i snang ba nub par nye ba na// bde gshegs sras dang bcas pas byin brlabs te// 'od gsal lhan cig skyes pa'i don rtogs nas// lha dang lha mo dpag tu med pa yis// sna tshogs mchod pas bdag gi sngun bsu zhing*// rang snang dri med chos kyi dbyings rang bzhin// rnam dag bde ba can gyi zhing khams der// bde chen sems kyis bde blag bgrod gyur cig /zhing der dmar ser 'od kyi phung po'i dbus// rab mang rin chen padma'i ze'u 'bru la// dge slong bye ba 'bum dang thabs gcig pa'i// chos rje 'od dpag med pa mthong gyur cig

/rgyal sras tshogs kyis yongs bskor bcom ldan 'das// thun mtshams 'char ka'i nyin byed ltar dmar ba// 'od 'bar blta bas mi ngoms de mthong nas// byang chub chen por lung bstan thob gyur cig /dge tshogs legs byas rnam par dkar ba'i 'bras// ngo mtshar yongs rdzogs dpal dang ldan pa'i lus// dpag med sprul nas bcom ldan 'das de la// bstod dbyangs rgya mtshos shis pa brjod gyur cig /byams chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang kun tu bzang*// spyan ras gzig dbang mthu chen thob la sogs// rgyal sras rnams dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing*// rnam thar tshul la mnyam par 'jug gyur cig /rnam thar rgya mtsho sgyu ma ltar sbyangs pas// theg mchog rgya mtsho'i thabs rnams kun bzung ste// ye shes rgya mtsho'i rtogs pa rab thob nas// srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro kun sgrol gyur cig /zhing khams rgya mtsho rtag tu sbyong ba dang*// tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho dag ni spel bar byed// sems can rgya mtsho rab tu smin byas te// smon lam rgya mtsho rnams ni 'grub gyur cig /ji ltar sngon gyi bde bar gshegs rnams kyi// thugs bskyed smon lam mdzad stobs ci 'dra ba// de ltar bdag gis sems can ma lus tshogs// myur du sangs rgyas sa la 'god par shog /ces 'od dpag tu med pa la bstod pa yan lag bdun pa smon lam dang bcas pa 'di/ karma pa de bzhin gshegs pas mdo smad kyi sa'i cha rma chu 'gram du sbyar ba'o/ 'di ni rje nyid kyis nyin zhag bdun khor yug tu bde ba can gyi zhing gi bkod pa mngon sum ltar gzigs pa'i skabs su shugs 'byung du gsungs pa yin no/ /zhes dang*/ gzhan yang kun mkhyen dol po pas mdzad pa'i bde smon sogs byin rlabs dang ldan pa rnams kyang brjod do// de nas bzod par gsol ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag tu med pa la sogs te phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa gdan 'dzoms pa'i spyan sngar bdag cag la sogs pa 'gro ba mang po'i don mdzad par gsol ba'i skabs 'dir/

bdag cag dus ngan pa'i sems can spyod pa dman zhing ma dag pas ma 'tshal ba dang*/ bag ma mchis pa'i dbang gis lus ngag yid gsum gyi spyod pa nyon mongs pa dang 'dres pa dang*/ mchod pa'i dngos po chung zhing ngan pa dang*/ gtsang sbra ma phyed pa mdo las byung ba'i cho ga bzhin tu ma lcogs pa la sogs pa 'khrul zhing nongs pa thams cad 'phags pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams la bzod par gsol zhing mchis na thugs brtse bar dgongs te bzod par bzhes shing*/ 'phral dang yun du bdag cag gi sgrib par mi 'gyur bar byin gyis brlab par ci gnang*/ de nas gshegs su gsol ba ni/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang thugs rjes byon par mdzod// mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams kyis bdag cag sems
